@@ -92,0 +93,24 @@ function sort<T>(compare: (a: T, b: T) => Order, list?: readonly T[]): any {
+/** Returns a tuple of arrays where the first contains elements the predicate accepted and the second contains rejected elements, both in original order */
+function partition<T>(
+  f: (x: T, index: number, arr: T[]) => boolean,
+  list: readonly T[]
+): Tuple<T[], T[]>
+function partition<T>(
+  f: (x: T, index: number, arr: T[]) => boolean
+): (list: readonly T[]) => Tuple<T[], T[]>
+function partition<T>(
+  f: (x: T, index: number, arr: T[]) => boolean,
+  list?: readonly T[]
+): any {
+  switch (arguments.length) {
+    case 1:
+      return (list: readonly T[]) => partition(f, list)
+    default:
+      const acc: [T[], T[]] = [[], []]
+      list!.forEach((x: T, i: number) => {
+        f(x, i, list!) ? acc[0]!.push(x) : acc[1]!.push(x)
+      })
+      return Tuple(acc[0], acc[1])
+  }
+}
